name: blockle-htlc-btc
description: BTC leg of the Blockle non-custodial atomic-swap exchange: a native Bitcoin Script HTLC (OP_SHA256 hashlock + OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY refund) and a PSBT builder for lock / redeem-with-preimage / refund-after-timelock. Hashlock is sha256(preimage), matching the shared PROTOCOL.md.
